item.title: ‘Good health policy’: Alberta’s calls on Ottawa to relax nicotine pouch rules
item.description: Alberta says federal policy appears to have coincided with growth on the black market, where unregulated nicotine pouches are widely available online with no age restrictions.

item.title: ‘Good for the economy’: Premier Moe praises Canada-India uranium trade deal
item.description: Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe is praising Canada's uranium deal with India, saying it is good for the province's economy as pulse tariffs persist.

item.title: Calgary Mayor to meet with NHL Commissioner to discuss World Cup of Hockey bid
item.description: The possibility of Calgary being chosen to host the 2028 World Cup of Hockey will be a topic of discussion when Mayor Jeromy Farkas meets with the NHL Commissioner on Tuesday.

item.title: Musqueam First Nation signs Aboriginal rights deal with Ottawa – read the full agreement
item.description: Chief Wayne Sparrow of the Musqueam Indian Band told Global News that the agreement signed with the federal government does not include private properties in that region.

item.title: Alberta mulls ditching time switch — again — as B.C. moves to permanent daylight
item.description: Danielle Smith said along with Saskatchewan's use of year-round CST, B.C.'s shift raises questions about whether Alberta should aim for consistency across the western provinces.

item.title: AI-generated CRA tax scams increasing, cybersecurity experts warn
item.description: “With AI, they can craft emails that are so believable compared to years past,” Kaseya cybersecurity expert Miles Walker told Consumer Matters.

item.title: Patsy or paranoic: Court hears conflicting theories in Winnipeg multiple-murder trial
item.description: An accused mass killer was either driven by drug- and alcohol-induced paranoia or was a pawn in a frame-up when he fatally shot five people in a Winnipeg rooming house,.

item.title: Hundreds of sea lions have taken over a Vancouver Island beach
item.description: California sea lions have taken over the beach at Vancouver Island's Deep Bay. A marine biologist says they're at the end of their northern fishing tour and awaiting a herring run.

item.title: Vincent Massey Trojans get comeback win to open high school hockey city championship
item.description: The Trojans are one win away from a second straight high school city championship after a 3-2 Game 1 win over Oak Park.

item.title: Flyers trip struggling Maple Leafs 3-2 in shootout
item.description: Matvei Michkov and Trevor Zegras scored in a shootout and the visiting Philadelphia Flyers beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 3-2, extending the hosts' losing streak to four games on Monday.
